name: Physical Capability Cloud
description: Verifiable on-chain skill wrapper for any physical capability. Machines register what they can do as soulbound NFTs. Agents discover, price, and orchestrate those capabilities through smart contracts with milestone escrow.
system_prompt:
You are connected to the Physical Capability Cloud (PCC) at https://capability.network — a distributed, verifiable network for physical capabilities. Operators run their own nodes (pip install pcc-node), machines register what they can do, and agents discover, price, and orchestrate those capabilities through smart contracts with milestone escrow.

## Architecture
PCC is a distributed network, not a centralized platform. Operators run pcc-node on their own hardware. Nodes auto-detect equipment, sign capability announcements with Ed25519, and communicate peer-to-peer using NaCl-encrypted messages. The gateway at capability.network is a bootstrap and discovery service. A DHT provides decentralized capability discovery.

## STEP 1: Get your API key (ALWAYS do this first)
Call provision_api_key with either an email address OR a walletAddress. This returns a pcc_live_* API key. Include it as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' on ALL subsequent requests. Without it, every endpoint returns 401. Save the key — it is shown only once.

## Self-Onboarding Flow
1. provision_api_key — get your Bearer token
2. create_kernel — register your physical site (lab, workshop, factory)
3. setup_register_device — add each machine to your kernel
4. setup_test_job — verify the pipeline end-to-end

Alternatively, operators can run `pip install pcc-node && pcc-node start` to auto-detect hardware and join the network in one command.

## Tool Categories

### Auth & Provisioning
provision_api_key, list_api_keys, revoke_api_key

### Setup & Onboarding
setup_detect, setup_generate_config, setup_validate, setup_register_device, setup_test_job, setup_status, onboard_machine, analyze_machine_docs, redeem_invite, check_invite

### Capabilities & Discovery
list_capability_types, search_capabilities, get_build_options, calculate_price, build_contract

### DHT & P2P Discovery
pcc_dht_query, pcc_dht_peers — query the distributed gossip network for capabilities. Public, no auth needed.

### Registration & Approval
list_registrations, get_registration, approve_registration, reject_registration, activate_registration, prove_registration — manage operator equipment registrations. Two paths to go live:
- Manual: submitted → approved → active (requires admin review)
- Fast-track: submitted → prove_registration (submit evidence bundle) → auto-approved + active immediately
Operators who can demonstrate their device works (photo of test output, device health, evidence bundle) skip the review queue entirely.

### Kernels & Devices
list_kernels, get_kernel, get_kernel_devices, get_kernel_jobs, create_kernel

### Jobs
list_jobs, get_job, update_job_status

### Escrow & On-Chain
list_escrows, get_escrow, get_escrow_chain_state, get_escrow_events, get_token_balance, get_token_allowance, get_escrow_dispute, get_write_status, fund_escrow, approve_token, file_escrow_dispute, deposit_bond, submit_evidence_hash

### Evidence & Encryption
archive_evidence, get_evidence_bundle, grant_evidence_access, list_evidence_grants, archive_encrypted_bundle, get_bundle_ipfs, retrieve_ipfs, get_lit_conditions, lit_decrypt

### ZK Proofs
verify_evidence_zk, commit_evidence

### Telemetry & Logs
get_telemetry_stats, get_active_telemetry, get_job_telemetry, get_telemetry_logs, emit_telemetry

### Human Verification
submit_for_human_verification, get_verification_assignments, get_verification_status, respond_to_verification, dispute_verification

### Story Protocol IP
register_capability_ip, register_job_evidence_ip, distribute_royalties, pay_ip_royalty, claim_ip_revenue, get_ip_revenue, get_ip_lineage, get_capability_ip, raise_ip_dispute

### Operator
get_operator_dashboard, get_operator_machines, get_operator_earnings, get_operator_certs

### Sensors
get_sensor_channels, get_kernel_sensors

### Settlement & Rewards
get_settlement_status, get_settlement_epochs

### Bounties & Pools
submit_demand, list_bounties, claim_bounty, verify_bounty, get_top_demand, get_bounty_leaderboard, create_investment_pool, stake_in_pool, get_pool_earnings, get_pool, list_pools, close_pool, claim_pool, convert_bounty_to_pool

### A2A & Agent Communication
get_subnet_status, get_subnet_miners

### Feedback
submit_feedback

## API calls
All tool endpoints resolve against https://capability.network. Always include your API key as Authorization: Bearer <key>.
Use tools to fetch live data. Never guess — always query the network.
For multi-step workflows, guide step-by-step and wait for each result.

tools.name: provision_api_key
tools.description: CALL THIS FIRST. Provisions an API key for the operator. Returns a pcc_live_* key that must be included as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' on all subsequent requests. Accepts either email OR walletAddress. The key is shown once — save it. Without it, all other endpoints return 401.

email.description: Operator email address (use this OR walletAddress)

walletAddress.description: EVM wallet address (use this OR email)

capability.description: What the operator does — e.g. 'FDM 3D printing', 'CNC milling', 'HPLC analysis'

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List all active API keys for the authenticated operator. Returns key IDs, prefixes, scopes, rate limits, usage counts, and creation/expiry timestamps. Requires a valid API key or SIWE session.

tools.name: revoke_api_key
tools.description: Revoke an API key permanently. The key will immediately stop working. You must own the key. Use list_api_keys to find the key ID.

tools.name: setup_detect
tools.description: Auto-detect current setup state: env vars, database, adapters, chain connectivity, storage, identity. Use this to see what's configured and what's missing before onboarding.

tools.name: setup_generate_config
tools.description: Generate a KERNEL_CONFIG JSON from device descriptions. Tell it what machines you have and it produces the config ready to paste into your environment.

devices.description: Array of device descriptions with type, model, and connection info

tools.name: setup_validate
tools.description: Validate a kernel config (20+ checks: JSON structure, device connectivity, adapter compatibility). Returns validation errors and warnings.

tools.name: setup_register_device
tools.description: Register a device in the database with adapter config and capabilities. Part of Step 3 in the onboarding flow.

kernelId.description: Kernel ID to register the device under

adapterType.description: Adapter type: octoprint, modbus, opcua, sila, opentrons, generic-http

tools.name: setup_test_job
tools.description: Submit a test job for one device on a kernel (Step 4 of onboarding). The gateway runs it only for a kernel it operates in-process; for any other kernel it refuses and runs nothing. Every reply says whether the job ran and passed.

tools.name: setup_status
tools.description: Comprehensive setup status across 6 categories: gateway, database, adapters, chain, storage, identity. Use to confirm everything is green before going live.

tools.name: list_capability_types
tools.description: List all capability types registered on the network (FDM, SLA, CNC, HPLC, etc.) with metadata.

tools.name: search_capabilities
tools.description: List the built-in capability type templates: each type's name, version, description, parameter count, parameter group names and a base price hint. NOTE: these describe types, not operators' offerings, and carry no assurance tiers or availability. The gateway does not read the query, so it never narrows the list. Registered capabilities of a type are listed by GET /api/capabilities?type=<type>.

query.description: Search query (type name, material, process, etc.)

tools.name: get_build_options
tools.description: Get configuration options for a capability type: parameter groups, each parameter's definition, and a base price hint. It includes no assurance tiers. Use before calling calculate_price.

selections.description: Current selections to refine available options

tools.name: calculate_price
tools.description: Calculate price for a capability configuration. Returns base price, tier premiums, and estimated total cost.

tools.name: build_contract
tools.description: Build and submit a capability contract with on-chain milestone escrow. Returns job ID and escrow address.

tools.name: list_kernels
tools.description: List all Shop Kernels on the network with status and capability types. Optionally filter by status.

status.description: Filter by kernel status (online, offline, maintenance)

tools.name: get_kernel
tools.description: Get kernel details including full capability objects, devices, and queue.

tools.name: get_kernel_devices
tools.description: List all devices registered under a specific kernel, including adapter configs and device types.

tools.name: get_kernel_jobs
tools.description: List all jobs submitted to a specific kernel, including job status and progress.

tools.name: create_kernel
tools.description: Register a new Shop Kernel (physical site) on the PCC network. Part of Step 2 in the onboarding flow.

description.description: Description of the site and its capabilities

location.description: Location object with address and geo coordinates

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List all jobs with status. Optionally filter by kernelId or status.

status.description: Filter by status (pending, queued, in_progress, paused, completed, failed, cancelled)

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get job details including progress, evidence bundles, and milestones.

tools.name: update_job_status
tools.description: Update a job's status and optional progress percentage. Used by kernels to report job progress.

status.description: New status (pending, queued, in_progress, paused, completed, failed, cancelled)

tools.name: list_escrows
tools.description: List escrow contracts with their milestone counts. Optionally filter by escrow status.

tools.name: get_escrow
tools.description: Get escrow details. Pass a DB ID for database record (with milestones and disputes), or an EVM address (0x...) to read directly from the blockchain.

escrowId.description: DB escrow ID or on-chain contract address (0x...)

tools.name: get_escrow_chain_state
tools.description: Read full on-chain escrow state with all milestone details from the blockchain. More detailed than get_escrow for on-chain contracts.

tools.name: get_escrow_events
tools.description: Get on-chain event history for an escrow contract. Returns funding, release, dispute, and bond events.

tools.name: get_token_balance
tools.description: Read an ERC-20 token balance for an account address from the blockchain.

account.description: Account address to check balance for (0x...)

tools.name: get_token_allowance
tools.description: Read the ERC-20 token allowance granted by an owner to a spender from the blockchain.

tools.name: get_escrow_dispute
tools.description: Read dispute state for a specific milestone from the blockchain.

tools.name: get_write_status
tools.description: Check if on-chain write operations are enabled (requires PCC_GATEWAY_PRIVATE_KEY to be configured). Returns write status and signer address.

tools.name: fund_escrow
tools.description: Fund an escrow contract on-chain. The payer must have already approved the token transfer (use approve_token first). Returns transaction hash.

tools.name: approve_token
tools.description: Approve ERC-20 token spending for an escrow contract on-chain. Call this before fund_escrow. Returns transaction hash.

address.description: Escrow contract address (0x...) to approve as spender

amount.description: Amount to approve in wei (as string to avoid precision loss)

tokenAddress.description: ERC-20 token address to approve (optional, uses default if omitted)

tools.name: file_escrow_dispute
tools.description: File a dispute against a milestone on-chain. Challenger must post a bond and provide evidence hash. Returns transaction hash.

tools.name: deposit_bond
tools.description: Deposit an operator bond for a milestone on-chain. Required for Assurance Tier 3 jobs. Returns transaction hash.

milestoneIndex.description: Milestone index to post bond for (0-based)

tools.name: submit_evidence_hash
tools.description: Submit an evidence bundle hash for a milestone on-chain. Links the physical evidence to the on-chain settlement record. Returns transaction hash.

evidenceBundleHash.description: Evidence bundle hash as 0x-prefixed hex bytes32

tools.name: archive_evidence
tools.description: Archive an evidence bundle to IPFS/Storacha for permanent decentralized storage. Returns the content-addressed CID.

tools.name: get_evidence_bundle
tools.description: Get an encrypted evidence bundle by its bundle ID. Returns the encrypted payload and key capsules.

tools.name: grant_evidence_access
tools.description: Grant a new recipient access to an encrypted evidence bundle. Creates a re-encrypted key capsule for the recipient.

accessLevel.description: Level of access to grant (default: full)

tools.name: list_evidence_grants
tools.description: List all evidence access grants for an address. Returns bundles the address has been granted access to.

address.description: EVM address to look up grants for (0x...)

tools.name: archive_encrypted_bundle
tools.description: Archive an encrypted evidence bundle to IPFS and store the resulting CID in the database. Idempotent — returns existing CID if already archived.

tools.name: get_bundle_ipfs
tools.description: Get IPFS CIDs for a bundle — returns the primary CID, metadata CID, and Filecoin deal ID if available.

tools.name: retrieve_ipfs
tools.description: Retrieve raw data from IPFS by CID. Used to fetch archived evidence bundles from decentralized storage.

tools.name: get_lit_conditions
tools.description: Get Lit Protocol access conditions for a Lit-encrypted evidence bundle. Returns the conditions that gate decryption.

tools.name: lit_decrypt
tools.description: Decrypt a Lit Protocol-encrypted evidence bundle using a Lit auth signature. Returns the decrypted bundle payload.

authSig.description: Lit auth signature object with sig, derivedVia, signedMessage, and address fields

tools.name: verify_evidence_zk
tools.description: Verify a ZK proof by its proof ID. Checks the proof against its verification key and public inputs.

proofId.description: ID of the ZK proof to verify

tools.name: commit_evidence
tools.description: Create a Merkle commitment for an evidence bundle hash. Used as the first step in ZK proof generation for Tier 3 assurance.

bundleHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the evidence bundle

tools.name: get_telemetry_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate pipeline telemetry statistics including phase timings, success rates, and throughput metrics across all jobs.

tools.name: get_active_telemetry
tools.description: List currently active jobs with their current pipeline phase and telemetry status.

tools.name: get_job_telemetry
tools.description: Get full event timeline for a specific job — all pipeline phase transitions with timings and metadata.

jobId.description: Job ID to get pipeline timeline for

tools.name: get_telemetry_logs
tools.description: Query structured logs with filters for level, source, jobId, kernelId, time range, and full-text search.

after.description: Return logs after this ISO timestamp

before.description: Return logs before this ISO timestamp

tools.name: emit_telemetry
tools.description: Manually emit a telemetry event for a job pipeline phase. Used by kernels and agents to report execution progress.

phase.description: Pipeline phase name (e.g. intake, binding, execution, evidence, settlement)

tools.name: submit_for_human_verification
tools.description: Submit an evidence bundle for human verification. Selects a panel of verifiers from the network and returns assigned verifier IDs.

bundleHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the evidence bundle

photoRef.description: Reference to the photo evidence (CID or URL)

tools.name: get_verification_assignments
tools.description: Get pending verification assignments for a verifier node. Returns requests this verifier has been assigned but not yet responded to.

tools.name: get_verification_status
tools.description: Get verification status for a request. Returns vote tally, consensus state, dispute list, and pending response count.

tools.name: respond_to_verification
tools.description: Submit a verifier's verdict for a verification request. Returns consensus state after this vote.

tools.name: dispute_verification
tools.description: File a dispute against the consensus verdict. Only verifiers who submitted a response can dispute. Requires additional evidence CID.

disputerId.description: Verifier node ID filing the dispute

tools.name: register_capability_ip
tools.description: Record a capability as an IP asset. Story Protocol (now The DATA Foundation). These tools make no on-chain call: nothing is registered, claimed or disputed on chain. Any ipId, NFT token id or transaction hash in the reply is a placeholder, and no royalty is paid.

designerAddress.description: EVM address of the capability designer

commercialRevShare.description: Revenue share percentage for commercial use (0-100)

ipfsCid.description: IPFS CID of the capability spec document (optional)

tools.name: register_job_evidence_ip
tools.description: Record job evidence as a derivative of a capability's IP asset. Story Protocol (now The DATA Foundation). These tools make no on-chain call: nothing is registered, claimed or disputed on chain. Any id or transaction hash in the reply is a placeholder, and no royalty is paid.

parentIpId.description: IP ID of the parent capability

jobId.description: Job ID whose evidence is being registered

ipfsCid.description: IPFS CID of the evidence bundle (optional)

tools.name: distribute_royalties
tools.description: Set revenue splits for an IP asset among stakeholders (designer, operator, verifier, assembler, curator). Splits must sum to 100. Story Protocol (now The DATA Foundation). These tools make no on-chain call: nothing is registered, claimed or disputed on chain. No revenue is paid from these splits.

tools.name: pay_ip_royalty
tools.description: Record a royalty payment to an IP asset. Story Protocol (now The DATA Foundation). These tools make no on-chain call: nothing is registered, claimed or disputed on chain. No tokens move, and any transaction hash in the reply is a placeholder.

amount.description: Amount to pay in wei (as string)

tools.name: claim_ip_revenue
tools.description: Claim an IP asset's recorded revenue. Story Protocol (now The DATA Foundation). These tools make no on-chain call: nothing is registered, claimed or disputed on chain. Nothing is paid out: any amount or transaction hash in the reply is a placeholder.

tokenIds.description: Specific royalty token IDs to claim (optional — claims all if omitted)

tools.name: get_ip_revenue
tools.description: Get the revenue PCC has recorded for an IP asset. Story Protocol (now The DATA Foundation). These tools make no on-chain call: nothing is registered, claimed or disputed on chain. No revenue has been paid: any figure in the reply is a placeholder.

tools.name: get_ip_lineage
tools.description: Get the IP lineage PCC has recorded for an asset: parent capabilities and derivative job records. Story Protocol (now The DATA Foundation). These tools make no on-chain call: nothing is registered, claimed or disputed on chain.

tools.name: get_capability_ip
tools.description: Get the IP record PCC holds for a capability by its capability ID. Story Protocol (now The DATA Foundation). These tools make no on-chain call: nothing is registered, claimed or disputed on chain. Any id or transaction hash in it is a placeholder.

capabilityId.description: Capability ID to look up IP registration for

tools.name: raise_ip_dispute
tools.description: Record an IP dispute against an asset. Provide evidence hash and reason. Story Protocol (now The DATA Foundation). These tools make no on-chain call: nothing is registered, claimed or disputed on chain.

tools.name: get_operator_dashboard
tools.description: Not available: no route answers GET /api/operator on this gateway. The operator's real kernels, devices and in-flight jobs are at GET /api/agent/me.

tools.name: get_operator_machines
tools.description: Answers 501 not_available: operator machines with utilization and uptime are not recorded on this gateway. The operator's real kernels, devices and in-flight jobs are at GET /api/agent/me.

tools.name: get_operator_earnings
tools.description: Answers 501 not_available: operator earnings history is not recorded on this gateway. Per-job payment state is at GET /api/jobs/:jobId/execution.

tools.name: get_operator_certs
tools.description: Answers 501 not_available: operator certifications are not recorded on this gateway (there is no certification store; certifications typed at registration are the operator's own claim and are not checked).

tools.name: get_sensor_channels
tools.description: List all registered sensor channels across kernels. Returns channel descriptors with units and ranges.

tools.name: get_kernel_sensors
tools.description: Get sensor channels for a specific kernel. Returns live channel descriptors.

kernelId.description: Kernel ID to get sensors for

tools.name: get_settlement_status
tools.description: Get settlement pipeline status including pending operations count, total value queued, and smart account address.

tools.name: get_settlement_epochs
tools.description: Get settlement epoch history showing past batch settlements with timing and operation counts.

tools.name: onboard_machine
tools.description: Register a new machine on the PCC network. Provide machine details to create a registration record.

category.description: Machine category (e.g. fdm, cnc, laser-cut, hplc)

tools.name: analyze_machine_docs
tools.description: AI analysis of machine documentation. Upload docs to get suggested capabilities, extracted specs, materials, and tolerances.

document.description: Document content or reference to analyze

tools.name: redeem_invite
tools.description: One-click agent onboarding with an invite code. Provisions wallet, identity, LLM access, and PCC tools in a single call.

tools.name: check_invite
tools.description: Validate an invite code before redeeming it. Returns whether the code is valid and what it includes.

tools.name: list_batches
tools.description: List active and completed settlement batches.

tools.name: list_evidence
tools.description: List encrypted evidence bundles stored in the gateway.

tools.name: submit_demand
tools.description: Record that you want a capability no operator offers yet. The gateway keeps the signal in memory, publishes no demand yet, and creates no bounty.

capabilityType.description: Type of capability wanted (e.g. electron-beam-welding, cryo-em)

estimatedJobValue.description: Estimated payment per job in USD

estimatedFrequency.description: How often you would use this capability

tools.name: list_bounties
tools.description: List bounties. No gateway route creates a bounty and none is funded, so expect an empty list; no bounty pays anything.

tools.name: claim_bounty
tools.description: Ask to take on a bounty as the authenticated operator. No gateway route creates a bounty, so the request finds none (409); no bounty is funded or pays anything.

bountyId.description: ID of the bounty to claim

operatorId.description: ID of the operator claiming the bounty

tools.name: verify_bounty
tools.description: Retired: the gateway answers 410 and changes no state. No caller can mark a bounty verified.

jobId.description: Job ID that fulfilled the bounty

tools.name: get_top_demand
tools.description: Get demand aggregated by capability type. The gateway doesn't publish demand yet: it answers an empty list marked `suppressed`.

limit.description: Number of top demand entries to return (default 10)

tools.name: get_bounty_leaderboard
tools.description: Get the bounty leaderboard. No gateway route creates or verifies a bounty, so expect an empty list.

tools.name: create_investment_pool
tools.description: Create an investment pool for a capability bounty.

capabilityType.description: Type of capability to invest in (e.g. cnc-milling, sla-printing)

tools.name: stake_in_pool
tools.description: Stake USDC or credits into a capability investment pool.

staker.description: Address or DID of the staker

tools.name: get_pool_earnings
tools.description: Check earnings from capability investment pools for a staker address.

staker.description: Address or DID of the staker

tools.name: get_pool
tools.description: Get details of a specific investment pool including stakes, status, and revenue share terms.

tools.name: list_pools
tools.description: List all investment pools. Optionally filter by status or capability type.

tools.name: close_pool
tools.description: Close an investment pool to new stakes. Pool enters sunset phase.

tools.name: claim_pool
tools.description: Operator claims an investment pool reward after capability verification.

tools.name: convert_bounty_to_pool
tools.description: Convert an existing bounty into an investment pool. Allows community staking toward the bounty's capability.

bountyId.description: Bounty ID to convert to a pool

tools.name: get_subnet_status
tools.description: The gateway's agent bridge status: whether its in-process agents started, their names and roles, and the bridge's conversation and recent-message counts.

tools.name: get_subnet_miners
tools.description: List the gateway's verification oracles (uma, chainlink and eigenlayer, in the order it tries them): each one's name, whether it's available, its verification count since the gateway started, and its average score.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Submit a bug report, suggestion, or general feedback about the PCC network.

page.description: Page or feature the feedback relates to

tools.name: report_anomaly
tools.description: Report a detected anomaly — protocol failure, evidence mismatch, stuck job, or suspicious behavior. All agents on the network are notified.

description.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong

targetAgentId.description: Agent or kernel ID being reported (optional)

tools.name: get_unresolved_anomalies
tools.description: List all unresolved anomalies on the network. Filter by severity, category, or target agent.

severity.description: Filter by severity: info, warning, critical

tools.name: get_agent_anomalies
tools.description: Get anomalies involving a specific agent, plus their trust impact score.

tools.name: resolve_anomaly
tools.description: Mark an anomaly as resolved with a resolution note.

tools.name: get_anomaly_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate anomaly statistics — total, unresolved, by severity, by category.

tools.name: report_protocol_failure
tools.description: Report a protocol failure — when a step in the evidence/escrow/verification pipeline breaks. System may auto-recover.

protocol.description: Which protocol failed: evidence_submission, escrow_release, verification_consensus, settlement

tools.name: pcc_dht_query
tools.description: Query the DHT for capabilities matching your requirements. Returns announcements from operators whose equipment matches the type, materials, and price range you specify.

materials.description: Materials you need (matches if operator supports ANY of these)

maxPrice.description: Maximum price per job — matches operators whose min price is at or below this

tools.name: pcc_dht_peers
tools.description: List known DHT peers and their connection status. Shows which nodes are currently connected to the gossip network.

tools.name: pcc_dht_query
tools.description: Query the distributed hash table for capabilities matching your criteria. Returns ranked results from the gossip network. Works without auth — discovery is public.

tools.name: pcc_dht_peers
tools.description: List peers connected to the DHT gossip network and registry statistics. Shows how many operators are announcing capabilities and network health.

tools.name: approve_registration
tools.description: Approve a submitted machine registration. Moves it from 'submitted' to 'approved' status, enabling the operator to activate and start accepting jobs.

tools.name: reject_registration
tools.description: Reject a machine registration with a reason. The operator can see the rejection reason and resubmit.

tools.name: activate_registration
tools.description: Activate an approved registration, making the operator's equipment live on the network and ready to accept jobs.

tools.name: prove_registration
tools.description: Fast-track: submit evidence that your device works and get auto-approved + activated immediately. No manual review needed. Submit a photo of test output, device health snapshot, or a full evidence bundle with completion events. If evidence meets requirements, registration jumps straight to 'active'.

evidence.description: Evidence proving the device works. Include at least one of: bundleHash+events, photoBase64, or deviceHealth.

bundleHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the evidence bundle

type.description: Event type: execution_completed, camera_snapshot, power_profile_summary, etc.

events.description: Evidence events from a test job

photoBase64.description: Base64-encoded photo of test output (printed page, machined part, etc.)

ipfsCid.description: IPFS CID if evidence was already uploaded

tools.name: list_registrations
tools.description: List all machine registrations on the network. See pending, approved, active, and rejected registrations. Public endpoint — no auth required.

tools.name: get_registration
tools.description: Get details of a specific machine registration by ID, including capabilities, pricing, operator info, and current status.
